description: A video series' end card: the short card every episode of the series ends on, the same each time, with one line of the episode's own. Says whether the series ends on its own card or the brand's, whether the owner chose that, its own card and the brand's (made by Marsell or the owner's own video, with a clip or still of each), whether the owner's AI was asked for one, and the series' look, tone and accounts (what a card made for it follows). Without series, every video series. A series made as a show of its own makes its own card with its first episode; the business's own channel and the series setup made end on the brand's card until the owner gives them their own. Reading spends nothing.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

series.description: The series' id or exact name. Leave out when the business has one video series.
